def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid separator row/column splits the canvas into two repeated panels;
    # use the populated panel to fill the corresponding blank one.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Actual separators are the uniform color that also forms the full separator intersection.
    if sep_rows and sep_cols:
        color = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
        sr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[r])]
        sc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h))]
        if sr and sc:
            rb = [-1] + sr + [h]
            cb = [-1] + sc + [w]
            # Copy each panel's contents from its matching panel in adjacent repeat block.
            # The exemplar is the bottom-left panel; repeat it through all row blocks,
            # while preserving any already populated pixels in that exemplar.
            r0, r1 = sr[-1] + 1, h
            c0, c1 = 0, sc[0]
            seed = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
                a,b = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
                for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
                    x,y = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
                    # Same-sized panels: copy seed exactly, clipping if necessary.
                    for i in range(a,b):
                        for j in range(x,y):
                            si, sj = i-a, j-x
                            if si < len(seed) and sj < len(seed[0]):
                                out[i][j] = seed[si][sj]
            return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full separator lines by their repeated non-background color.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    if not rows and not cols:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = grid[rows[0]][0] if rows else grid[0][cols[0]]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        a,b=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            x,y=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            data=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
            score=sum(v != bg and v != sep for row in data for v in row)
            panels.append((score,a,b,x,y,data))
    _,_,_,_,_,seed=max(panels,key=lambda p:p[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for _,a,b,x,y,_ in panels:
        for i in range(a,b):
            for j in range(x,y):
                out[i][j]=seed[(i-a)%len(seed)][(j-x)%len(seed[0])]
    return out
PY
